name: Scary Experiment
summary: Hello VR gorillas, welcome to a "Terrifying" and "Fun" experience. In this game you can explore different maps, laugh with friends, and discover secrets. There are lots of things to do. You can even make fun of a slow possessed gorilla. This game is inspired by OG Fun Monkey Horror, Scary Baboon, and Gorilla Tag, the game that started the gorilla movement.
